newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan big banks seen in red if Nikkei below 15,000.
newsitem.headline: Japan big banks seen in red if Nikkei below 15,000.

text.p: All the top 20 Japanese banks may be forced into the red at the end of the fiscal year to March 31 if the key Tokyo stock average falls to around 15,000 points, banking sources said on Friday.

Such a drop in the Nikkei 225 index could force some banks to scale back plans to write off hefty bad loan holdings and raise foreign investor worries about the reliance of Japanese banks on latent profits from securities holdings.
"With stocks now below 18,000, Japan's 20 city, long-term credit and trust banks will be in an emergency situation when they come to close their books," a banking source said.
